items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Jimmy Hall rang me up, and he says, 'Me and my wife were out in the country and I heard you being interviewed.'

ctx.x: We can wrap up pretty soon here, because I know you have to get going. Here’s a hard question maybe. How’s that for an introduction?

Yeah wait a minute, that’s what Phil Schaap says. I was talking to him and we got going, and he says, “I’m going to look that up,” he says, “you’ve got me worried.” He says, “I used to think I knew everything, but when you questioned it—” and that same program after I got back, Jimmy Hall rang me up, and he says, “Me and my wife were out in the country and I heard you being interviewed.” He says, “Man,” he says, “when I was being interviewed, this guy would get me so wrapped up I couldn’t talk.” He knew…
Well maybe it’s time for another book, huh?
